selection_rule: Each fold/start chosen by calibration cost among converged rank-feasible fits with calibration Gamma min overlap>0.5. Family score = RMS omitted development energy + 0.5 RMS omitted gap + 0.5 RMS omitted anchor gap + 2(1-mean omitted overlap) + 0.5 worst omitted energy + 4 max(0.7-min omitted Gamma overlap,0).
validation_scope: Entire omitted angle excluded from objective, action/generic seed, mass estimation and rank constraints. Function families and loss were developed on historical Heff data; these are refit diagnostics after development, not untouched prospective validation.
prior_scope: Three node values per potential at 1/3/5.1 degrees; wide node bounds and weak node second-difference penalty are priors. Node bounds do not imply bounds at all other angles. Below 2.13 degrees there are no calibration Heff data.
state_scope: Energy-ranked top3 overlap. Rank constraints use overlap assignment at Gamma/K of calibration angles, not exact irrep certification; no Chern result is inferred.
scope: Original six-coefficient local Hamiltonian, quadratic kinetic energy, common mass inferred jointly, 16 global fit variables. No beta, no momentum tunneling, no upstream TAPW audit, no native/DFT refit.
fit_data_scope: Stored 36 training k points per calibration angle. Reported curves use the 61-point Gamma-M-K-Gamma path. Numerical diagnostics are path-only.
